requestedDelegate.ownership: services/**; approved pgx/transitive inventory additions only in root THIRD_PARTY.yml

reviewer: implementation agent; independent database/auth and operational review remains required

sourceTree.algorithm: SHA256 sorted UTF8 repo-relative path + NUL + uint64be byte length + exact file bytes; receipt itself excluded

rootDependencyInventory.changedScope: approved pgx and five transitive entries only

protocolContract: HTTP request/response shapes, release-v1 signed manifest and assignment bytes, and capability_hashes semantics unchanged; no origin/method/namespace restrictions inferred from unsigned data.

implementation.storage: Tenant-scoped adapter with explicit reader/editor/publisher envelope derived from validated request token+route. Public published-delivery reads have separate methods/context.
implementation.postgres: Pinned pgx5.11.0. Separate migration/runtime roles; startup rejects owner/superuser/BYPASSRLS/CREATEROLE/CREATEDB authority and missing FORCE RLS/checksum/durable-write prerequisites.
implementation.transactions: Tenant head lock serializes immutable artifact/state or assignment history/head, exact idempotency response, deterministic audit chain and pending outbox in one commit. Failed operations reserve no key; uncertain commits retry the same key.
implementation.bounds: 4 pool connections by default (max16), 5s operation default (100..15000ms), 2s connect/rollback timeout, 20MiB driver message bound, 16MiB payload, 64 tenant artifacts, audit/outbox page1..100.
implementation.audit: Event hash is fixed struct JSON with hash empty; exact bytes persisted as BYTEA. Nested map keys sorted. Tenant transition commitment and prior audit hash checked before mutation and across pages. Not externally anchored or DBA-resistant.

checks.scope: existing local JSON HTTP/CLI/owned-integer-VM compatibility; separate from PostgreSQL tests

realPostgresReceipt.scope: real isolated local PostgreSQL transactional/RLS tests; no hosted/GA claim
realPostgresReceipt.tests: real PostgreSQL HTTP multi-instance concurrency, tenant/RBAC/RLS, immutability, unknown schema/runtime-role refusal, bounded query deadline, pre/post publication commit interruption and actual immediate database restart
limitations: Private Unix-socket test authentication is limited to this deleted test cluster. No production database credentials were created or altered.
Local config bearer authority remains bootstrap-only; no identity provider, organization onboarding or hosted auth qualification.
Pending outbox records are not dispatched. No backup/restore, multi-zone, CDN, operational, mobile OTA, physical-device or GA evidence.

httpCompatibilityReceipt.scope: local HTTP release -> linked Swift verifier -> trusted local owned integer VM; no full Swift, device OTA or hosted qualification
httpCompatibilityReceipt.sourceBuildCorrespondence: Existing CLI/Swift/VM executables were snapshotted; this script does not attest their source-build correspondence or sandbox malicious local tools.
httpCompatibilityReceipt.ambientToolOverrides: ignored; explicit private executable snapshots are forced
httpCompatibilityReceipt.authorization: unauthenticated admin and cross-tenant reads rejected

observedBehaviors: Twenty concurrent identical uploads across two independent service instances produce one exact idempotent result and one audit/outbox pair.
Changed method/body under the same tenant/key conflicts; another tenant can independently use the same key. Failed publication before validation reserves no key.
Two concurrent next-sequence promotions produce exactly one200/one409. New-sequence rollback survives service restart; stale publication is rejected.
Unscoped and cross-tenant database reads expose zero rows; cross-scope inserts and payload-selected tenant overrides fail. Reader/editor publication is denied.
Runtime ownership, elevated role attributes, missing/unknown migration checksum and production mode fail startup.

Artifact, audit and idempotency rows resist owner update/delete. The applied schema also installs immutable guards/restricted runtime grants for assignment and outbox history; validation/publication flags and channel sequence are monotonic.
Maximum uint64 assignment sequence round-trips PostgreSQL numeric20; audit cursor is bounded and corruption of tenant audit head blocks mutation.
Exact16MiB payload round-trips; larger payload fails. SQL context cancellation terminates a deliberate pg_sleep.

Before-commit abort and actual immediate database crash leave no public offer. A committed publication with lost response retains its offer. Every same-key retry resolves to one publication/audit/outbox result while preserving committed upload/validation baseline.
Actual loopback TCP HTTP uploads/validations/publications/public downloads execute against PostgreSQL for distinct iOS and Android channel scopes with valid signatures.
Private test cluster has verified data-directory marker, disabled TCP listener, private Unix socket, fsync/full_page_writes/synchronous_commit enabled, and is deleted after testing.
limitations: No hosted service, managed provider, real customer account/membership lifecycle, SSO, credential revocation lifecycle or production identity/RBAC qualification.
DB authentication tests use trust only inside a newly-created0700 Unix-socket test cluster. SCRAM/TLS deployment and secret rotation remain unqualified.
DB credentials and app process remain trusted; RLS defends tenant binding/predicate mistakes, not a compromised service process or privileged DBA. Independent security review remains open.
Outbox is transactional pending-local-only storage. Dispatcher, leases/fencing/attempt records, external delivery and charge reconciliation are not implemented.
No object storage/CDN, backup restore, multi-zone failover, RPO/RTO, retention/quota/deletion/export service or production operational evidence.
Stored organizations/projects are scoped tenant-head identities, not full onboarding/application/runtime/build/release-group control-plane registries.
No physical phone, mobile cold-start, full Swift owned VM, device OTA, immutable public-package FieldLog adoption, D0 or GA qualification.
